intro.text: The divisions of Kerztian society. The warrior DaiKeen mark themselves with an X, and the Kerztians who ambushed the Diem wore theirs as a scar rather than a tattoo.
The three DaiKeen of Kerzta: warriors who serve as its soldiers, priests who keep the Ker'reen faith under the A'kar, and merchants, from whom the country's kings have lately been chosen.

description.text: The merchant DaiKeen is made up of traders. In each of the four Choosings of the past two centuries, Kerzta's king came from its ranks.
Warriors usually go into battle armoured and armed with swords and zinkallin, and tattoo an X on their foreheads.
The priests teach and oversee the Ker'reen religion for the Kerztian people, answer to the high priest called the A'kar, and carry a square scar on the forehead.

There are signs of a fourth group forming, warrior-priests who appear to have the A'kar's backing. Its members cut X-shaped scars into their foreheads, often over their earlier marks, shave their heads and fight without armour.
Ais has heard rumours that the A'kar may let followers of Ker'reen who are not Kerztian be adopted into DaiKeen families.
